title: ACCESS-ESM1.6 virtual stores
description: Byte-reference indexes of ACCESS-ESM1.6 historical simulation output (native model output, 1850-2021), read in place from the netCDF files on the ACCESS-NRI pilot bucket ct-esm1-6 on Pawsey Acacia. No data is copied. Each dataset is published as a GDAL multidimensional VRT, kerchunk Parquet, an Icechunk repository with virtual references, a flat Parquet refs store and a STAC collection. Drafts.
